prompts.name: cluster-namespace-inventory
prompts.prompt: I want to import the `payments-prod` namespace from my cluster into ConfigHub. It has 3 Deployments, 3 Services, 4 ConfigMaps, an HPA, a PDB, a ServiceAccount + Role + RoleBinding, a NetworkPolicy, and a ResourceQuota. How should I split this into Units?

prompts.name: helm-already-splits
prompts.prompt: I'm running `cub helm install cert-manager jetstack/cert-manager --version v1.17.2`. Should I separate the CRDs into their own Unit?

prompts.name: per-resource-request
prompts.prompt: Can I just put every Kubernetes resource in its own ConfigHub Unit? That way I can validate each one independently.
